# Javier Lera {.hero-name}

<div class="role">Assistant Professor of Economics</div>
<div class="accent-rule"></div>

I am an **applied economist** whose research lies at the intersection of health economics, public economics and social policy. My work focuses on socioeconomic inequalities, ageing, well-being and the evaluation of public policies using quantitative methods.
